correctness.rationale: Under right-action multiplication of order-preserving total self-maps on [n], Green R-kernels are exactly consecutive-interval partitions. The one constant c_r in a cross-section forces r fixed by every selected map. Each band idempotent adjacent collapse e_i chooses one endpoint; two consecutive equal-direction collapses produce a length-two transient orbit under a product and hence are forbidden, so directions alternate. If r has ≥3 points to one side, the forced distal e and idempotent triple-block collapse h produce a nonidempotent product, so r−1≤2 and n−r≤2. This proves nonexistence for n≥6 structurally. For every allowed root the stated per-block endpoint map is idempotent, order-preserving, kernel-distinct and closed; direct-product bands Q_{r−1}×Q_{n−r} give count 2,3,2,1 for n=2,3,4,5 and uniqueness. Independently enumerated all candidate band R-sections through n4 and checked canonical closure through n5. No non-band or other transformation monoids claimed.
